title: POST /api/v1/chat 200 response body (v1)
description: Mirrors gateway-api ChatResponse.java (null fields are omitted). Blocked and failed calls use error.v1.json instead.

replayOf.description: Present only when status is IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY: the original invocationId.

risk.description: Risk action applied (for example ANNOTATE). Absent when nothing was flagged.

dataSensitivity.description: Added in v1 (additive, optional). The data-sensitivity level recorded on this call's ledger row. Absent for IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY, whose row is not classified.

firstTokenMs.description: Added in v1 (additive, optional). The ledger row's first_token_ms. Streams only; never present on POST /chat, so absent there.
